overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Utility Committee was scheduled to meet on August 4, 2026, to review financial statements, receive a Director of Public Works and Utilities report, and discuss utility infrastructure matters including a water tower cell phone lease, capital improvement planning, and Lift Station 8 information.

agenda.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report
Water Tower Cell Phone Lease Information

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review financial statements as part of standard reports and discussions. This item was set to provide an update on the financial status of Village utility operations.

discussions.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report
discussions.body: The committee was expected to receive a report from the Director of Public Works and Utilities. This report was scheduled to cover operational updates and other matters related to public works and utility services.

discussions.item: Water Tower Cell Phone Lease Information
discussions.body: The committee was set to discuss information regarding a cell phone lease arrangement involving the water tower. Details on this lease agreement and any related decisions were scheduled for consideration.
The committee was scheduled to discuss Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) matters. This discussion was expected to address planned infrastructure projects and improvements for the Village.
The committee was set to review information regarding Lift Station 8. This discussion item was expected to cover updates or concerns related to this wastewater infrastructure component.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total period and a three-minute time limit per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Expected to consider water tower cell phone lease information
Scheduled to discuss Capital Improvement Plan
Set to review Lift Station 8 information
title: Utility Committee Meeting - 2026-08-04
